This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing and submitted no solve job. The case needs two unit types that `list_models` doesn't offer.

- **`Compressor` (C101):** it raises the offgas to PSA feed pressure. The nearest model is `syn001.liquid_pump`, which is for liquids, and `syn001.valve` only lowers pressure. Using either would be a substitute, which the instructions rule out.
- **`PressureSwingAdsorber` (PSA):** it separates hydrogen from tail gas. The nearest model is `syn001.component_separator`, which applies fixed split fractions. It has no adsorption, bed, pressure-equalization or purge behaviour, so it would not do what the case's unit does. The case's optimized decisions (`pressure_equalization_fraction` and `hydrogen_purge_fraction`) and its metrics (`hydrogen_recovery`, `hydrogen_purity`, `compression_power_kW`, `tailgas_fuel_index`) belong to this unit and have no equivalent here.

The remaining units map to available models: `OFFGAS` to `feed_source`, `S101` to `stream_splitter`, and `H2REC` and `FUEL` to `product_sink`. I did not check the case's `native_pyomo_conservation_model` property package or its component names (H2, CH4, benzene_vapor) against what this version offers, because the missing units already settle the outcome.

The nearest option, syn001.component_separator, applies fixed split fractions and has no bed, pressure-equalization or purge behaviour, so using it would be a substitute for the case's PSA unit. No revision was built and no solve was run."}, "claims": []}
